```{python}
import rdata
wa_churn_url = "https://github.com/tidymodels/modeldata/raw/7ab5d8a31e014c35a7d063de33d5eec44f4c20ce/data/wa_churn.rda"
# download the file
import urllib.request
urllib.request.urlretrieve(wa_churn_url, "wa_churn.rda")
# load the file
wa_churn = rdata.parser.parse_file("wa_churn.rda")
```


```{python}
target_column = 'churn'
feature_columns = [col for col in wa_churn.columns if col != target_column]

train = wa_churn.iloc[0::2] # get even-numbered rows
test = wa_churn.iloc[1::2] # get odd-numbered rows


d3 = DecisionTreeClassifier().fit(
    X=train[feature_columns],
    y=train[target_column]
)

d4 = DecisionTreeClassifier().fit(
    X=test[feature_columns],
    y=test[target_column]
)

d5 = d3.predict(test[feature_columns])
d6 = d4.predict(train[feature_columns])

d7 = accuracy_score(test[target_column], d5)
d8 = accuracy_score(train[target_column], d6)

```
